speaker: The Minister of State for Transport (Mr Murali Pillai) (for the Minister for Transport)
text: Over the last few years, the Land Transport Authority (LTA) has been increasing the bus services in tandem with the estate’s growth, with new connections to amenities and MRT stations in Choa Chu Kang and nearby towns.

speaker: The Minister of State for Transport (Mr Murali Pillai) (for the Minister for Transport)
text: These include changes to bus services 301, 983 and 991.

speaker: The Minister of State for Transport (Mr Murali Pillai) (for the Minister for Transport)
text: LTA will continue to engage community stakeholders as we review our bus services under the BCEP.

speaker: Mr Don Wee (Chua Chu Kang)
text: I have one supplementary question for the Minister of State.

speaker: Mr Don Wee (Chua Chu Kang)
text: I also thank LTA for improving the bus connectivity as well as the road safety of my Brickland residents over the past four years.

speaker: Mr Don Wee (Chua Chu Kang)
text: So, I wonder if a specific, thorough review can be conducted to improve the bus connectivity for residents staying around Keat Hong Close.
